newsitem.title: FRANCE: RESEARCH ALERT - Schneider rating cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Schneider rating cut.

text.p: French brokerage house Cheuvreux de Virieu turned negative on electrical equipment supplier Schneider, citing its disappointing first-quarter results.
The share was down 4.72 percent at 321 francs at 1115 GMT, while the bourse's CAC-40 index was 0.7 percent higher, after Cheuvreux cut the rating to 3 (no action) from 2 (buy).

The firm said Schneider's first-quarter turnover of 10.6 billion francs -- up three percent but down two percent at constant structure and exchange rates -- was below its forecast. It said the persistent lack of investment in France and Germany was negative.
